alt: Liver lobule (NIH BioArt) - plates of hepatocytes radiating from the central vein, with two magnified insets. The portal-tract inset labels the arterial endothelium, bile-duct epithelium, portal fibroblasts and hepatic progenitor cells; the sinusoid inset labels hepatocytes, Kupffer cells, hepatic stellate cells and the fenestrated sinusoidal endothelium.
